title: Bessent, The Yen And US Yields
text:
Bessent, The Yen And US Yields

Will Denyer

Gavekal Research | 5 Aug 2026

Scott Bessent says he will do “whatever it takes” to help Japan prop up the ailing yen “in a way that helps the American economy.” The US Treasury secretary’s qualification is important. It strongly suggests that while the US administration wants the yen to appreciate, it very much does not want Japan to sell down any of its armory of US treasuries—which make up the bulk of Japan’s US$928bn in official holdings of foreign securities—to raise US dollar cash to fund interventions in the foreign exchange market; that would push up long-term US interest rates. This points to another course of action for the US on the yen.Last Friday’s US intervention to support the yen hardly suggests a “whatever it takes” commitment. According to Bessent’s “to do” note artfully left for the press to see, he intended to buy US$5-10bn-worth of the Japanese currency, which is a rounding error in the yen foreign exchange market.
